svg.title: Accuracy across requested token budgets
svg.desc: Debate leads at 100 requested thinking tokens. The single-agent average leads the three displayed methods at every budget from 500 to 10,000 tokens. At 1,000 tokens: 41.8% single agent, 37.9% sequential agents, 38.8% debate. Table 1 averages over four models × two datasets (FRAMES and MuSiQue). Requested token ceilings, not identical actual consumption. The token axis is logarithmic. Three of the seven evaluated methods are shown.
svg.metadata: https://arxiv.org/html/2604.02460v2 | Table 1, Average rows; v2, 11 April 2026
